card.line: Geshur was a small kingdom northeast of Bashan whose people Israel never drove out, and it became the place where David's son Absalom took refuge.

moments.title: Geshurites stay in the land
moments.text: The Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites. Geshur and Maacath kept living among the Israelites.

moments.title: A king's daughter marries David
moments.text: David's third son, Absalom, was born in Hebron. His mother was Maacah, the daughter of King Talmai of Geshur.

moments.title: Absalom flees to Geshur
moments.text: After Amnon's death, Absalom fled to Talmai, the king of Geshur, and stayed there three years. David mourned for his son every day.

moments.title: Joab brings Absalom home
moments.text: Joab saw that David longed for Absalom. Joab went to Geshur and brought Absalom back to Jerusalem.

moments.title: Absalom's vow made in Geshur
moments.text: Absalom told David he had made a vow while living in Geshur of Aram. He asked to go to Hebron to worship the LORD there.
